rules.description: Every package shall bear the name and description of the commodity contained therein on the principal display panel.
rules.recommendation_on_verified: No immediate manual action required based on automated detection.
rules.recommendation_on_review: Verify that the product name is clearly visible and legible on the principal display panel.
rules.recommendation_on_issue: Inspect the package display panel manually for the generic or common name of the commodity.

rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(b) & Second Schedule, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Net quantity shall be declared in terms of standard units of weight, measure, or count in metric terms.
rules.recommendation_on_verified: Net quantity declaration conforms to standard metric packaging format.
rules.recommendation_on_review: Verify that the declared net quantity and metric unit conform to standard measurement units.
rules.recommendation_on_issue: Check the label for a declaration of net quantity in terms of standard metric weight or volume.

rules.legal_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) & Rule 18(1), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
rules.description: Retail sale price of the package shall clearly indicate Maximum Retail Price (inclusive of all taxes).
rules.recommendation_on_verified: MRP declaration detected with positive price value.
rules.recommendation_on_review: Verify whether the detected price value includes the mandatory 'inclusive of all taxes' declaration.
rules.recommendation_on_issue: Search the label for a clearly printed Maximum Retail Price inclusive of all taxes.

rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer shall be mentioned.
rules.recommendation_on_verified: Manufacturer or packer details detected with address context.
rules.recommendation_on_review: Verify that the manufacturer/packer address contains sufficient location details, city, or postal PIN code.
rules.recommendation_on_issue: Locate the manufacturer, packer, or importer name and address declaration on the label.

rules.display_name: Month & Year of Manufacture or Packing
rules.description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured, packed, or imported shall be clearly mentioned.
rules.recommendation_on_verified: Manufacturing, packing, or best before date information detected.
rules.recommendation_on_review: Inspect date stamp or ink-jet printing on the package for manufacturing/packing month and year.
rules.recommendation_on_issue: Locate the date stamping on the crimp, seal, or label panel to verify manufacturing or packaging dates.

rules.description: Name, address, telephone number, and email address of the person or office who can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.
rules.recommendation_on_verified: Consumer care contact details (helpline or email) detected.
rules.recommendation_on_review: Ensure at least a valid helpline number, email, or physical consumer redressal address is readable.
rules.recommendation_on_issue: Review the package for a consumer care cell contact number, email address, or grievance redressal info.
